clauses.text: The basic eligibility criterion for entrance into Universities remains unchanged which is that a candidate must have passed the Class 12 examination from any recognized Board or equivalent
The basic eligibility criteria is a key factor for admission to all University and other examinations such as JEE and NEET at the National Level

Visit the Website(s) of the University / Organization / Institution and NOTE down the eligibility criteria for the Courses in which you intend to take admission (required Test/Subjects for appearing in CUET (UG) – 2024 This should be noted down for all University/ Universities and Courses where…
They should have studied these subjects at grade 12 or as prescribed by a particular University under their eligibility conditions for a particular programme
Where do I need to check the eligibility criteria or Subjects/ tests which I need to take for appearing in

CUET (UG)-2024 As the eligibility criteria for admission may be unique for each University, the participating Institutions will upload all the required criteria for their respective programs, on their website/s

Candidates are advised to satisfy themselves before applying on the Samarth platform (https://exams.nta.ac.in/CUET-UG/) that they meet the eligibility criteria laid down by the University they are applying to.
However, the candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria of that Course of University / Institution / Organization where they are seeking admission.
The scribe must also carry an Undertaking regarding educational qualification, etc, passport size photograph, valid government identity
A candidate may be required to opt for one of the 13 specified languages as the medium of the paper or as the language, as per desired University’s eligibility criteria
